text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: us-west2 spot GPU pool pressure detected. queue_length=4200, avg_wait_tokens=120k, 95pct_latency_tokens=3.2s. Auto-scaler attempted scale-ups but many failed. Potential service impact: increased 5xx and throttling on hosted API routes. @here

sasha (oncall): I'm paged, taking it. starting triage now.

mike (eng-sre): digging in. Do we have autoscaler logs? Could be hitting maxNodes or cloud provider refusing spot capacity.

anna (eng-platform): I see a flurry of spot preemptions over the last 7m. Preempt count 28 in the pool. Autoscaler is triggering, but several scale-up ops returned errors: 

```
scaleUp: 2025-11-08T14:12:09Z error: InsufficientCapacityError: requested 4 x A100 preemptible not available
scaleUpRetry: attempt 3 -> blocked by project quota (GPUs). current_gpu_quota=64, requested_total=68
```

luis (infra): Confirmed quota bump attempts failed earlier today; we have a hard quota at 64 gpus in us-west2 for this project. Some reserved dedicated jobs also running in the same zone.

mike (eng-sre): That explains failed scale-ups. Autoscaler shows backoff and then stalled state. Queue is growing because fallback routing to dedicated pools didn't trigger fast enough.

sasha (oncall): Customer impact? Jordan, any incoming CS tickets?

jordan (cust-success): Getting 3 reports from large customers about increased generation latency and a few timeouts. No broad outage reported yet, but error rate on /v1/generate spiked from 0.2% to 6% in last 10m.

anna (eng-platform): Can we force immediate fallback to region secondary (us-west1-dedicated) for high-priority customers? We have policy routes but the fallback threshold might be too conservative.

mike (eng-sre): We can, but need to ensure model variant compatibility and cost limits. Also circuit breaker TTL might block quick reroute. I can flip a canary policy to widen fallback and bump aggressive fallback TTL.

sasha (oncall): Do it. Prioritize prod customers A,B,C (list available to platform). Keep me posted.

deploy-bot: Rollout request by mike: widen-fallback-policy -> staged (1->100)

mike (eng-sre): Rolling policy now to all routes for us-west2. Patch applied.

anna (eng-platform): Patching routing rules and enqueuing immediate reconcilers. Also bumping autoscaler maxNodes from 80->90 as an emergency override (will check quotas again).

luis (infra): Can't increase maxNodes above quota. Request to CloudQuota team submitted 2h ago, not approved. We can spawn in us-east1 where quota unaffected; cross-region routing adds ~40-60ms latency.

sasha (oncall): For customers with strict latency SLAs, don't cross-region. For best-effort, route to us-east1 spot fallback.

mike (eng-sre): Deploying heterogeneous fallback: route non-SLA customers to us-east1 spots, SLA customers to dedicated us-west1. This should reduce queue pressure quickly.

incident-bot: NOTE: model-serving pool drained 12 nodes in last 5m due to preemption. KV cache warming will take ~3-5m for hot prefixes. Expect initial latency blips.

jordan (cust-success): Let me craft a brief status for affected customers: short note about transient latency due to spot interruptions and our mitigation (rerouting + autoscaler adjustments). Will wait for confirmation on impact windows.

mike (eng-sre): Observability: attaching relevant snippets from autoscaler and queue monitor: 

```
[autoscaler] 14:13:01 scaleUpAttempt id=abc123 status=FAILED reason=InsufficientCapacityError
[queue-monitor] 14:13:30 pending=3728 inflow_rate=250/s outflow_rate=60/s
[kv-cache] 14:14:05 miss_rate=78% for hot_prefixes
```

anna (eng-platform): After policy flip, I see traffic shifting: us-west2 outflow_rate up to 180/s then falling; us-east1 inflow starting. Queue dropping from 4200 -> 1600 over 4m.

sasha (oncall): Good. Any long-term actions?

luis (infra): Immediate: escalate quota increase with cloud provider + reserve a small dedicated pool in us-west2 for SLA customers. Medium: adjust fallback thresholds to trigger earlier under spot volatility. Long: add multi-zone reserved capacity to avoid single-zone spot storms.

mike (eng-sre): Also need to tune autoscaler to detect repeated InsufficientCapacityError and proactively trigger cross-region fallback earlier instead of retrying in-zone backoffs. I'll open a follow-up ticket.

jordan (cust-success): Sent customer status update. Included expected recovery ETA: 10-15 minutes and note that we're prioritizing SLA traffic to dedicated capacity.

deploy-bot: rollout widened to 100% for us-west2 routes.

incident-bot: UPDATE: queue_length=1120, pending_tokens=34k, error_rate now 1.8%.

sasha (oncall): I'll stay on the thread for the next 30m to ensure stability. Handing a soft on-call note to tom (next oncall) in 20m.

mike (eng-sre): Filed tickets: INFRA-4923 (quota escalation), PLAT-3117 (autoscaler preemptibility handling), SRE-8831 (reserve-dedicated-us-west2).

anna (eng-platform): Postmortem owner assigned: mike. We'll plan a blameless postmortem and update runbooks for spot storms.

jordan (cust-success): Customers acknowledged the status note, appreciate the transparency. No escalations yet.

sasha (oncall): Thanks team. Closing active paging. Will re-open if error_rate > 3% or queue > 1500.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: marked mitigated by sasha at 14:24:30. Metrics will be monitored for 2 hours.
